role: Author-support reconciliation of exact source metadata with independently inspected original paper pages.

primary_page_evidence.locator: p.5771, Introduction, right column: PRS2000 cloning source and derivation from PRS1 (ATCC12633).
p.5772, Methods, right column: PCR amplification from wild-type PRS2000 chromosome.
p.5773, Table1: PRS2000 strain row and pHS100 construct row.

interpretation: The paper describes PRS2000 as a wild-type derivative of PRS1 (ATCC12633), identifies PRS2000 as the pcaR cloning source and traces the PCR construct to its chromosome. This reconciles a lineage-level ENA source annotation with the UniProt experimental-strain annotation; it does not make the strain names universally interchangeable.
sequence_identity: Exact ENA AAA57136.1 and UniProt Q52154 translation equality is a separate computed result in primary-sequence-bridge.json. It establishes those deposited sequences, not complete-genome identity, universal native initiation choice, or equivalence to KT2440.
limitations: PRS1 and PRS2000 remain separately named source/experimental contexts.
The printed292-residue versus deposited291-residue discrepancy and Met1/23/45 uncertainty remain unresolved as specified in the record/dossier.
